text.EN: Watching the weather. Stay focused.
text.TL: Binabantayan ko ang panahon. Manatiling nakatutok.

text.EN: Storms bring trouble. Don't linger out in the open.
text.TL: Bagyo ang nagdadala ng gulo. Huwag kang tumambay sa bukas na lugar.

text.EN: Sky looks nasty. Get your head in the game.
text.TL: Madilim ang langit. Maghanda ka sa anumang darating.

text.EN: Bad weather makes it easy for them to sneak up. Stay alert.
text.TL: Mas madali silang makalapit kapag masama ang panahon. Maging alerto.

text.EN: Wind is masking noises. Keep your ears open and back off.
text.TL: Tinatabunan ng hangin ang mga ingay. Maging mapagmatyag at umatras ka.

text.EN: Clouds are gathering. I don't plan on getting caught out here.
text.TL: Makulimlim na. Wala akong balak abutan ng ulan dito sa labas.

text.EN: Weather is turning. Stop wasting time chatting.
text.TL: Papasama ang panahon. Huwag magsayang ng oras sa pakikipag-usap.

text.EN: Fog or rain will blind us. Keep your weapon ready.
text.TL: Mabubulag tayo sa hamog o ulan. Ihanda ang armas mo.

text.EN: Eyeing the clouds. You'd better find cover too.
text.TL: Tinitingnan ko ang mga ulap. Mabuti pang maghanap ka na rin ng masisilungan.

text.EN: A storm is brewing. I'm focusing on shelter.
text.TL: May paparating na bagyo. Naghahanap ako ng masisilungan.

text.EN: The weather is the main thing on my mind right now.
text.TL: Ang panahon ang pangunahing iniisip ko ngayon.

text.EN: Looks like the skies might turn on us soon.
text.TL: Mukhang sasama ang lagay ng panahon maya-maya.

text.EN: Watching the clouds roll in. Hope we stay dry.
text.TL: Tinitingnan ang pagdating ng mga ulap. Sana manatiling tuyo.

text.EN: Cold wind's picking up today. Harder to stay warm.
text.TL: Lumalakas ang malamig na hangin ngayon. Mahirap magpainit.

text.EN: Can't afford to get soaked out here without a fire.
text.TL: Hindi puwedeng mabasa rito kung walang apoy.

text.EN: Hoping the rain holds off until we finish our runs.
text.TL: Sana huwag munang umulan hanggang sa matapos ang mga lakad natin.

text.EN: Weather's unpredictable lately. Keeping an eye on the sky.
text.TL: Pabago-bago ang panahon kamakailan. Laging nakatingin sa langit.

text.EN: Temperature is dropping fast. Gonna be a cold night.
text.TL: Bumababa nang mabilis ang temperatura. Magiging malamig ang gabi.

text.EN: Just thinking about finding a roof before the weather hits.
text.TL: Iniisip ko lang makahanap ng bubong bago dumating ang ulan.

text.EN: Clear skies for now, but you never know when it'll shift.
text.TL: Maliwanag pa naman ngayon, pero hindi mo masasabi kung kailan magbabago.

text.EN: Watching the weather.
text.TL: Binabantayan ang panahon.

text.EN: Rain coming.
text.TL: Uulan na.

text.EN: Cold wind.
text.TL: Malamig ang hangin.

text.EN: Dark clouds.
text.TL: Makulimlim.

text.EN: Weather's turning.
text.TL: Papasama ang panahon.

text.EN: Storm brewing.
text.TL: May bagyo.

text.EN: Need shelter.
text.TL: Kailangan ng masisilungan.

text.EN: Stay dry.
text.TL: Manatiling tuyo.

text.EN: Freezing out.
text.TL: Napakalamig.

text.EN: Windy.
text.TL: Mahangin.

text.EN: The weather is the main thing on my mind right now. How are you holding up?
text.TL: Ang panahon ang pangunahing iniisip ko ngayon. Kumusta ka naman?

text.EN: Chilly out here today. Make sure you bundle up and stay warm, alright?
text.TL: Malamig dito ngayon. Magsuot ka ng makapal at magpainit, ha?

text.EN: Looks like rain might fall. Let's make sure our dry clothes stay safe.
text.TL: Mukhang uulan. Siguraduhin nating ligtas ang mga tuyo nating damit.

text.EN: I was just watching the clouds. Hope you've got a warm fire waiting for you.
text.TL: Pinagmamasdan ko ang mga ulap. Sana may mainit kang masisilungan.

text.EN: Cold wind today, but seeing your face makes it feel a bit warmer.
text.TL: Malamig ang hangin, pero nakakabawas ng ginaw na makita ka.

text.EN: Hoping the bad weather passes over us without trouble. Stay dry out there.
text.TL: Sana lumampas ang masamang panahon nang walang gulo. Manatiling tuyo sa labas.

text.EN: Weather's rough, but we'll weather any storm together, my friend.
text.TL: Mabigat ang panahon, pero kakayanin natin anumang bagyo, kaibigan.

text.EN: If it starts pouring, come share some shelter with us.
text.TL: Kapag nagsimulang bumuhos ang ulan, sumilong ka kasama namin.

text.EN: Just keeping an eye on the sky so none of our people get caught in the wet.
text.TL: Binabantayan ang langit para walang mabasa sa mga kasamahan natin.

text.EN: Gloomy day outside, but good company makes all the difference.
text.TL: Madilim ang araw sa labas, pero iba talaga kapag may magandang kasama.
